description: Transform your entertainment experience with this powerful 7.1 Home Theatre System, designed to deliver immersive surround sound with stunning RGB LED lighting. The sleek black setup features a high-performance subwoofer accented with dynamic multi-LED effects and seven satellite speakers, each equipped with powerful drivers hidden behind premium grilles for crystal-clear audio output. Enjoy seamless Bluetooth connectivity for wireless music, movie, and gaming audio streaming, while the included remote control lets you manage all functions effortlessly. The dedicated centre channel speaker ensures sharp and clear dialogue, while the surround speakers create rich, room-filling positional sound for true cinematic impact. With its modern angular design and bold geometric styling, this system adds a striking visual appeal to any contemporary space. The speakers can be easily mounted across different locations such as your café, shop, terrace, office, or hall by extending the speaker wires as per your installation needs—making it a perfect blend of flexibility, performance, and style.
